title: Source-Induced Reflection in Balanced Shallow-Water Networks
summary: Width-balance conditions at a junction are often associated with reflectionless transmission, or transparency, in some one-dimensional wave models on networks. We show that, on cyclic networks, this identification is incomplete: local balance is a vertex-level condition, while transparency also requires synchronization of the path travel times.
